tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ground plane. Lit by aura and aura-cool; may carry the grid-dot pattern for open workspaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Paper: content surfaces (cards, chat column, tables). No border; lifted by elev-1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque floating paper when glass is off or unsupported; also the body under glass-strong.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, tool output, progress tracks, kanban board ground. Replaces --bg-inset and --mix-board-bg.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Current nav item and selected row. Neutral, never orange.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Barely-there edges: dividers, the rim where paper meets paper. Translucent so it blends over glass and aura. Depth comes from elevation, not lines.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Control edges (inputs, secondary buttons). Lightened on request: below the 3:1 WCAG non-text contrast on its own, so every control also carries the field fill and a solid focus ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Black. Primary text and headings on every surface, hover and selected. Also the default progress fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, agent roles. 4.5:1+ on every surface, hover and selected in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta (relative times, counts, section labels) on canvas, surface and surface-raised only. Fails 4.5:1 on selected: use ink-muted there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orange. The one brand hue: primary button fill, live-run dot, active tab underline. One orange fill per view. Overridable by the deployment's theme.css.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: black on orange (6.8:1). Never white on orange (3:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links, the MAIN tag, active states. On canvas, surface and accent-wash.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet orange ground: user message bubble, info notices, MAIN badge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every focusable control. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills and error text on canvas, surface and danger-wash. Always with a word (Delete, Failed): it sits near orange in hue.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Error notice and failed-run ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and the 75% quota fill. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Warning notice ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed states, connected integrations. Always with a word or check icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Success notice ground.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the narrow-screen side panel.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill that marks a control as a control: inputs, secondary buttons, segmented tracks. Replaces heavy borders.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid glass body for floating chrome over moving content: sidebar, composer, tab bar, toasts. Always with backdrop blur (blur-glass) and saturation.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass that holds text: menus, dialog panels, popovers. Keeps ink at 4.5:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Specular rim: 1px inset highlight on the top-left edge of glass, as if lit from above.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Outer rim of glass where it meets the scene. Defines the edge without a visible border.

tokens.name: aura
tokens.usage: Ambient orange light pooled on the ground plane behind content: empty chat, hero, the active workspace. Large, blurred, never behind body text at full strength.

tokens.name: aura-cool
tokens.usage: Cool counter-light opposite the aura, so the ground reads as a lit space, not a flat fill.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dot grid of the infinite canvas (dashboards, board, workspace views). 24px pitch.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Instrument Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "0xProto Nerd Font Mono", "0xProto", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-chat greeting and onboarding hero. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles: Agents, Teams, Admin, Quota.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Agent names on cards and the chat header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and modal headings inside a page.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: I reconciled the July balances and flagged two mismatches.
styles.usage: Agent replies and rendered markdown: the reading size, one step above body. Max line 68ch.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: descriptions, table cells, form help.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, tabs, session titles, inputs.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta: timestamps, owners, counts, field hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and tables. Never body copy.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, tool call arguments, IDs, keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between stacked meta lines, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, sidebar row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, control groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page title top margin, empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chat hero offset from top.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, kbd, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, code blocks, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the composer, glass panels, portraits.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, dots, tracks, and the expressive send button.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects. Roomier: 16px horizontal padding.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in rows and toolbars; 12px horizontal padding.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: prose-w
tokens.usage: Max width of the chat column and composer.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon box.

duration.note: Durations. Pair each spring with its own duration: the curve is shaped for it.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale down on pointerdown), color flips.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover fills, exits, tooltips leaving.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Fades and crossfades: streaming chunks, tab content, theme change.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Large surfaces fading: page enter, side panel scrim.

tokens.name: dur-spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Pairs with spring-smooth.

tokens.name: dur-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Pairs with spring-snappy.

tokens.name: dur-spring-pop
tokens.usage: Pairs with spring-pop.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay step between list items entering. Cap at 8 items (224ms).

easing.note: Springs are real damped-spring curves sampled into CSS linear(): physical motion without JS, run on the compositor.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for fades and anything entering without a spring.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only: things leave faster than they arrive.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Crossfades and theme change.

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Critically damped (k 260, c 32), no overshoot. Panels, sheets, the composer growing, the modal.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Under 1% overshoot (k 420, c 34). The selection pill sliding, tab underline, toasts, menus, list reorder.

tokens.name: spring-pop
tokens.usage: 6% overshoot (k 380, c 26). Small things only: press release, checkmarks, badges appearing, the send button.

blur.note: Backdrop filters for glass. Keep glass areas small; never blur behind body text you could make opaque.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Floating chrome: sidebar, composer, toasts.

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs (glass-strong).

tokens.name: blur-aura
tokens.usage: Softness of the aura light pools on the ground.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Saturation boost behind glass, so color bleeds through like real glass.

shadow.note: Natural light from above: a tight contact shadow plus a soft ambient one. Each plane up is lighter, softer and farther.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Paper at rest: cards, chat column, tables.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Lifted: hovered cards, the composer, the sidebar glass.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Floating: menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: elev-4
tokens.usage: Focus plane: dialogs and sheets, while the scene behind recedes.
